subject: Vendor portal enrollment & PO/invoice requirements for Goldcrest
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@goldcrest.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@goldcrest.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration and PO terms for Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well. We're ready to onboard Redwood as a supplier in Goldcrest's AP portal so we can start issuing POs and process invoices. Quick checklist of what our portal and procurement team will require before we can provision a vendor ID: 

- Legal entity name as it should appear on invoices
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT ID for EU entities)
- W-9 (for US vendors) or equivalent tax certificate
- Bank account verification document (voided check or bank letter)
- Remit-to instructions and preferred payment method (ACH/wire)
- Example invoice (PDF) matching your preferred template
- Any compliance attestations (SOC 2 link, ISO certs)

Attached: Goldcrest_vendor_portal_instructions.pdf with field mappings and required file formats. Important notes from AP:
- PO number must appear on the invoice header; invoices without PO will be rejected
- Invoice header must match registered legal name exactly
- We separate VAT line items; please provide VAT breakdown if invoicing EU customers
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless otherwise agreed in contract

Can you send the items above and confirm whether Redwood supports electronic invoicing (Peppol/EDI) or if you'll upload PDFs to our portal? Also let us know who will be your AP contact for follow-ups.

Thanks,

--
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Goldcrest AI
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@goldcrest.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO terms for Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear checklist and the portal instructions. We're ready to proceed. Per your list, please find the primary items attached and summarized below: 

Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Tax ID (EIN): 83-2712345
W-9: attached (Redwood_W9.pdf)
Bank verification: attached (Redwood_bank_verification.pdf) — ACH routing and account masked on the stub
Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  - ACH (preferred): Redwood Inference, Inc. / ACH details on Bank verification (will provide securely by return)
  - Wire: contact billing@redwood.ai for wire instructions
Suggested invoice template: https://docs.redwood.ai/invoices/template-2027.pdf (attached example inside the vendor_profile workbook)
SOC2 attestation: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2-report (public link)

We do support portal PDF uploads and can also accept EDI/Peppol workflows with our finance partner — let me know which you prefer and we'll enable it.

I've CC'd Lauren Bishop (AP Manager) who will help with bank verification and any tax questions. If you prefer a signed vendor agreement first, we can complete DocuSign today.

Attachments: Redwood_W9.pdf | Redwood_bank_verification.pdf | Redwood_vendor_profile.xlsx

Best,

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0197
From: procurements@goldcrest.ai <procurements@goldcrest.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO terms for Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from our AP intake team: 

1) For portal provisioning we also need the company registration number (if applicable) and a point of contact for payment exceptions.
2) Please execute the attached vendor agreement via DocuSign (link below). The agreement contains our standard PO/pricing attachment and data processing clauses.
3) Invoices must be submitted as PDF attachments to the PO in the portal. If Redwood invoices with VAT you must include a separate VAT line and VAT registration number (if invoicing entities in the EU).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/signed/abc123-goldcrest

When you complete the DocuSign envelope and confirm bank verification, I'll route this to vendor provisioning and aim to return a vendor ID within 2 business days.

Regards,

--
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Procurement Manager
Goldcrest AI
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@goldcrest.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO terms for Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay / Karthik — looping in a couple of internal items from AP to make this smooth: 

- We will complete the DocuSign agreement this morning; Karthik will sign and I will countersign for billing.
- Bank verification: we prefer to send a secured bank verification letter via our banking partner rather than include full account details over email. Once the portal accepts the document we can update the account information in the portal.
- KYC: if you need legal formation docs (Articles of Incorporation) or a Certificate of Good Standing, we can attach those to the portal profile.
- Routing: please confirm the remit-to email/portal field where we should send invoice PDFs — if you have a specific vendor inbox (e.g., vendor-invoices@goldcrest.ai) we'll use that as a backup.

I'll attached a brief checklist for our side (Redwood_vendor_profile.xlsx) with mapped invoice fields so your portal team can match them automatically. 

Thanks — we'll sign the DocuSign now and send the bank verification via secure upload.

Best regards,

--
Lauren Bishop
AP Manager
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@goldcrest.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration and PO terms for Redwood Inference

Sanjay — confirming we've completed the DocuSign envelope and uploaded the bank verification to the secure portal link you provided. Attached: signed_vendor_agreement.pdf and Redwood_bank_verification.pdf (the latter was uploaded to your portal as well).

Please confirm when the vendor ID is created and that the first PO will include the net30 terms discussed. Also confirm the vendor inbox for invoice PDFs; we'll default to uploading to the portal but will also send a copy to billing@redwood.ai for our records if you want a separate backup.

Looking forward to getting the first PO issued. If there are any outstanding items from our side, please highlight them and Lauren will follow up immediately.

Thanks,

--
Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference
